prompt: Your week is already full when someone asks you to take on one more commitment. Which response protects your time most kindly?

options.text: Say yes and quietly drop something else
Ignore the request and hope it goes away
Give an honest, polite no and, if you can, suggest another time or person

explanation: A clear, kind no respects both the other person and your existing commitments; a vague yes helps neither of you.
